response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced and versatile senior engineer, but his background is almost entirely web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, D, Ember) rather than embedded firmware or network security. He lacks the two hard requirements: native-level Japanese proficiency (only English, Romanian, and basic German listed) and current, deep C/UNIX systems work — his C/C++ exposure is a brief 2014–2015 stint at National Instruments and a university project. There is no evidence of Linux kernel source analysis, LAN-switch/L2-L3 networking, MACsec, 802.1X, chip-vendor SDKs, or any security-module ownership. The gap between his profile and this role's core requirements is too large to justify an interview.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering across web, mobile, desktop and some embedded/hardware-adjacent work
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, test tooling, DevOps infrastructure, and authored testing libraries
Prior low-latency, high-throughput systems work (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic) and some C/C++ experience at National Instruments
concerns: No Japanese language ability — a hard requirement stated as native-level
No embedded firmware, LAN-switch, or network security experience (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF, SNMP, switch chips)
C for UNIX development is dated and peripheral; no Linux kernel analysis or source modification evidence

key_factors.factor: Limited/dated C and Linux kernel depth
